description: This PHP class defines a data model 'EmployeeDirectoryDetailedModel' for representing detailed employee information within a corporate directory API in the OrangeHRM system. It leverages traits and interfaces for serialization and normalization, and maps attributes from an Employee entity to a structured API response with OpenAPI schema annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes detailed employee data for API responses, mapping Employee entity properties to a structured schema with OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the model by setting the Employee entity and mapping its attributes for serialization.
